prompt: Which U.S. National Park was the first to be established after the Portland Trail Blazers won their only playoff series with LaMarcus Aldridge on the team?
answer:
The **Gateway Arch National Park** was the first U.S. national park established afterward.

The Trail Blazers’ only playoff-series victory with LaMarcus Aldridge was their **4–2 first-round win over the Houston Rockets in 2014**, completed on **May 2, 2014**. **Gateway Arch National Park** was designated on **February 22, 2018**.
